resources.string: If the app froze, Bluetooth dropped or the screen reset, send the system logs so the developer can find the cause. Nothing is collected or sent until you confirm.

The following will be collected and sent to your account, where only the developer can read it:

• Recent system crash, freeze and restart records (including Bluetooth and camera services)
• MapControl's last exit reasons
• Bluetooth status
• The recent system log

Phone numbers, email addresses, Bluetooth addresses, device names and coordinates are masked before sending. Logs are deleted after 30 days. Nothing is recorded in the background.
